summary: Use the unique modal color as background and the exact color-6 hollow rectangle as a frame. Gather the one other colored cue, test which top/bottom/left/right edges of its bounding box are completely filled, and erase the cue. If all four cue edges are full, fill the complete frame interior with the cue color; otherwise paint only the corresponding inner frame edges.
